arms.historical_band_label: historical baseline evaluation variability (SimpleViT, exp_04), context only

band_label: historical baseline evaluation variability (references and phases redrawn), context only

C50.delta: change in the C50 error against the ground truth, dB
C50.gap: C50 distance from the k = 0 prediction, dB

EDT.delta: change in the EDT error against the ground truth, seconds
EDT.gap: EDT distance from the k = 0 prediction, seconds

T60.delta: change in the GT-normalised error, percentage points
T60.gap: percent of the baseline prediction's T60

notes.band: historical baseline evaluation variability (references and phases redrawn), context only
notes.broader_population: every query with a finite g_alpha (not the paired mask)
notes.gl_free: logspec_mad and mag_rel_l2 are the Griffin-Lim-free readout of the same shift, computed on the model's direct log-magnitude output
notes.pipeline: waveform and acoustic gaps measure the sensitivity of the model-plus-Griffin-Lim pipeline, conditional on the per-query phase seed; the shared phase initialisation removes initialisation noise, but Griffin-Lim is a nonlinear inverse and can amplify a magnitude change
